mapper.select: select id userId, tel_no telNo, im_id imId from corgi_user_login where tel_no = #{telNo} limit 1

select id userId, tel_no telNo, im_id imId, new_gidar newGidar, new_sign_up newSignUp, new_message newMessage, new_follow_activity newFollowActivity, unregister_date unregisterDate, hide_visit hideVisit, ctime from corgi_user_login where id = #{userId}
mapper.update:
update corgi_user_login
new_gidar = #{userLogin.newGidar},
new_sign_up = #{userLogin.newSignUp},
new_message = #{userLogin.newMessage},
new_follow_activity = #{userLogin.newFollowActivity},
unregister_date = #{userLogin.unregisterDate},
hide_visit = #{userLogin.hideVisit},
im_id = #{userLogin.imId},
where id = #{userLogin.userId}
mapper.select: select d.`user_id` userId, d.`nickname`, d.`avatar`, d.avatar_status avatarStatus, d.avatar_check_status avatarCheckStatus, d.avatar_data_id avatarDataId, d.`height`, d.`weight`, d.`desc`, d.`role`, d.`hide_role`, d.`character`, d.background, d.bg_check_status bgCheckStatus, d.bg_data_id bgDataId, d.`group`, d.`hide_group`, d.`birthday`, d.`con`, d.`relation`, p.`city`, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, if(p.fuptime > 0, p.fuptime, p.uptime) `time`, `check_status` checkStatus, `date_status` dateStatus from corgi_user_detail d left join corgi_user_position p on p.user_id = d.user_id where d.user_id = #{userId}

select count(1) from corgi_user_detail
where (`nickname` = #{nickname} or `check_nickname` = #{nickname})
where (`nickname` = #{checkNickname} or `check_nickname` = #{checkNickname})
and user_id != #{userId}

select d.user_id userId, d.nickname, d.avatar, count(1) count from corgi_user_follow f1 left join corgi_user_follow f2 on f2.user_id = f1.user_id and f2.is_deleted = '0' and f2.follow_user_id != #{userId} join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = f2.follow_user_id where f1.follow_user_id = #{userId} and f1.is_deleted = '0' and f1.type = 'real' and d.user_id != #{userId} group by d.user_id order by count desc limit 8

select d.user_id userId, d.nickname, d.avatar, from corgi_user_detail d left join corgi_user_position p on d.user_id = p.user_id where d.avatar_check_status = 'verified' and p.city = #{city} and d.user_id != #{userId} and d.cime > #{date} order by d.cime desc limit 20
mapper.insert: insert ignore into corgi_user_position (`user_id`, `lat`, `lng`, `pt`, `uptime`, `real_lat`, `real_lng`, `locate_type`, `version`, `city`, `province`,`channel`) values ( #{position.userId}, #{position.lat}, #{position.lng}, point ( #{position.lng}, #{position.lat} ), #{position.uptime}, #{position.realLat}, #{position.realLng}, #{position.locateType}, #{position.version}, #{position.city}, #{position.province}, #{position.channel} );
mapper.select: select user_id userId, lat, lng, real_lat realLat, real_lng realLng, locate_type locateType, uptime uptime, city, province, channel, version from corgi_user_position where user_id = #{userId}
select user_id userId, lat, lng, real_lng realLng, locate_type locateType, uptime, city, province from corgi_user_position limit #{start}, #{size}
mapper.update:
update corgi_user_position set lat = #{position.lat}, lng = #{position.lng}, uptime = #{position.uptime}, fuptime = 0, locate_type = #{position.locateType}, pt=point(#{position.lng},#{position.lat}), real_lat = #{position.realLat}, real_lng = #{position.realLng},
`city` = #{position.city}, `province` = #{position.province},
`channel` = #{position.channel},
`version` = #{position.version} where user_id = #{position.userId}

update corgi_user_position set uptime = #{position.uptime}, real_lat = #{position.realLat}, real_lng = #{position.realLng},
locate_type = #{position.locateType},
`version` = #{position.version},
`channel` = #{position.channel},
fuptime = 0 where user_id = #{position.userId}
mapper.select: select distinct p.user_id from corgi_user_position p left join corgi_user_detail d on p.user_id = d.user_id where (d.avatar_status = 'influencer' or ( d.vip_status = 1 and d.vip_expire > now() ) or p.uptime > #{position.uptime}) order by st_distance_sphere(point(#{position.lng},#{position.lat}),p.pt) limit 50
select province from corgi_user_position where city like concat(#{city}, '%') and province is not null limit 1

select p.user_id userId, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, if(p.fuptime > 0, p.fuptime, p.uptime) `time`, p.locate_type locateType, d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, d.avatar_status avatarStatus, d.avatar_check_status avatarCheckStatus, d.height, d.weight, d.birthday, d.role role, d.hide_role hideRole, d.group `group`, d.hide_group `hideGroup`, d.hide_prefer_group `hidePreferGroup`, d.con con, d.relation, d.check_status checkStatus from corgi_user_position p join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = p.user_id where p.user_id = #{userId}

select p.user_id userId, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, if(p.fuptime > 0, p.fuptime, p.uptime) `time`, p.locate_type locateType, d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, d.avatar_status avatarStatus, d.avatar_check_status avatarCheckStatus, d.height, d.weight, d.birthday, d.role role, d.hide_role hideRole, d.group `group`, d.hide_group `hideGroup`, d.hide_prefer_group `hidePreferGroup`, d.con con, d.relation, d.check_status checkStatus from corgi_user_position p join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = p.user_id where p.user_id in ${inValue}

select d.user_id userId, d.nickname nickname, d.check_nickname checkNickname, d.avatar avatar, d.avatar_status avatarStatus, d.avatar_check_status avatarCheckStatus, d.role role, d.hide_role hideRole, d.group `group`, d.hide_group `hideGroup`, d.hide_prefer_group `hidePreferGroup`, d.con con, d.relation, d.desc, d.check_desc checkDesc, d.cime createTime, d.check_status checkStatus from corgi_user_detail d where d.user_id > #{userId} limit #{size}

select d.user_id userId, d.nickname nickname, d.check_nickname checkNickname, d.avatar avatar, d.avatar_status avatarStatus, d.avatar_check_status avatarCheckStatus, d.role role, d.hide_role hideRole, d.group `group`, d.hide_group `hideGroup`, d.hide_prefer_group `hidePreferGroup`, d.con con, d.relation, d.desc, d.check_desc checkDesc, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, if(p.fuptime > 0, p.fuptime, p.uptime) `time`, d.cime createTime, d.check_status checkStatus from corgi_user_detail d left join corgi_user_position p on p.user_id = d.user_id where d.nickname = #{nickname}

select d.user_id userId, d.nickname nickname, d.avatar avatar, d.avatar_check_status avatarCheckStatus, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, if(p.fuptime > 0, p.fuptime, p.uptime) `time` from corgi_user_detail d left join corgi_user_position p on p.user_id = d.user_id where d.avatar_status = 'influencer' and d.user_id not in ('8', '1') order by p.uptime desc limit #{start}, #{size}
select count(1) from corgi_user_position p left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = p.user_id where p.uptime >= #{time} and p.version != '0.0.0' and d.cime like concat(#{date} , '%')
select count(1) from corgi_user_login where ctime like concat(#{date}, '%') and tel_no not like '3%'

select distinct d.user_id from corgi_user_detail d
left join corgi_prefer_group g on g.user_id = d.user_id
where d.user_id in ${userId}
and d.role in ${role} and d.hide_role != '1'
and d.group in ${group} and d.hide_group != '1'
and g.group in ${preferGroup} and d.hide_prefer_group != '1'
and not EXISTS (select 1 from corgi_blacklist where (user_id = #{filterId} and black_id = d.user_id) or(user_id = d.user_id and black_id = #{filterId}))

select d.user_id userId, d.nickname nickname, d.avatar avatar, d.avatar_status avatarStatus, d.avatar_check_status avatarCheckStatus, d.cime createTime, d.uptime followTime, p.uptime `time` from corgi_user_detail d join corgi_user_position p on p.user_id = d.user_id where d.avatar_status = 'influencer' or p.uptime > #{time} limit #{start} , #{size}
select id from corgi_user_login where unregister_date > '0' and unregister_date <= #{date}
select d.user_id from corgi_user_detail d left join corgi_user_position p on p.user_id = d.user_id where d.birthday like concat('%', #{date}) and p.uptime > #{time} and avatar_check_status = 'normal'
mapper.update:
update corgi_user_detail
uptime = uptime,
`vip_status` = #{vipStatus},
`vip_expire` = #{vipExpire},
where user_id = #{userId}
